Trước khi chép, rửa tay, vệ sinh thân th: Before copying, wash your hands and attend to personal hygiene; brush your teeth or rinse your mouth. Keep your screen, keyboard and hands clean and dry, and place your device appropriately.
Mặc quần áo sạch, kín đáo, ngay ngắn; tr: Wear clean, modest clothing that covers the body appropriately. You may wear a Buddhist practice robe if convenient.
Không chép trong nhà vệ sinh, nơi ô uế,: Do not copy in a bathroom, an unclean or littered place, or during sexual intimacy. After using the bathroom or sexual intimacy, clean yourself before returning to the practice.
Ở nhà, nơi làm việc hay khi đi xa đều có: You may copy at home, at work or while away, provided the place is clean and you can practise respectfully. There is no fixed day or hour to wait for.
Ngồi ngay ngắn, thả lỏng và dành một kho: Sit upright and relaxed, and allow an amount of time you can comfortably manage. Reduce notifications, app switching, conversation and web browsing so you can focus on the sutra.
Có thể niệm Phật hoặc phát nguyện ngắn t: You may recite the Buddha’s name or make a brief aspiration before copying. Aim to understand the teachings and practise kindness, rather than chase page counts or rush to finish.
Đọc kinh mẫu trên màn hình, tự gõ từng c: Read the reference on screen, type each sentence yourself in the copying editor and reflect on its meaning. Check the reference to preserve the wording, complete sentences and correct order.
Bấm “Rà soát đoạn này” để tìm chỗ gõ sai: Press “Review this passage” to find incorrect, extra or missing text. Select an issue under “Locations to correct” to jump to it, edit directly in the copying editor, then review again.
Nếu cần đi vệ sinh, có việc riêng, buồn: Pause if you need the bathroom, have another task, or feel tired or sleepy. On returning, attend to cleanliness and reread the preceding passage before continuing.
